definitions.gloss: full authority; full powers; plenipotentiary powers
definitions.explanation: Complete authority to decide and act on a matter, often delegated by someone else. Used of business decisions and, in diplomacy, of envoys empowered to sign treaties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{全権|ぜんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{委|ゆだ}ねる→委ねる：10877_yudaneru⟧。
examples.english: To entrust full authority to the president.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全権|ぜんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}っている→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: She has full say over this matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全権|ぜんけん}⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{条約|じょうやく}→条約：04912_jouyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調印|ちょういん}→調印：14252_chouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: The government sent a plenipotentiary to the signing of the treaty.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全権|ぜんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{委|ゆだ}ねる→委ねる：10877_yudaneru⟧ / ⟦{委任|いにん}する→委任する：27012_ininsuru⟧: to give someone full authority
- {全権|ぜんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to hold all the power
- {全権|ぜんけん}⟦{大使|たいし}→大使：03391_taishi⟧: ambassador plenipotentiary
- {全権委任|ぜんけんいにん}: delegation of full powers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{権限|けんげん}→権限：10600_kengen⟧: authority attached to a position, of any extent; {全権|ぜんけん} is authority over everything in the matter
- ⟦{実権|じっけん}→実権：31741_jikken⟧: real power, as opposed to nominal power
